```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=TRUE)
if(params$action!='report' || (!is.null(params$options$action)&&params$options$action!='report'))
  stop('This notebook reads saved results only; fitting is not allowed')
here<-dirname(knitr::current_input(dir=TRUE))
source(file.path(here,'common.R'),local=TRUE)
if(!requireNamespace('eivGP',quietly=TRUE))stop('Install the matching eivGP package')
is_eiv<-identical(params$lane,'eivGP')
if(is_eiv) {
  if(nzchar(params$report_rds))report<-readRDS(params$report_rds) else {
    root<-if(nzchar(params$run_dir))params$run_dir else if(nzchar(params$results_root))params$results_root else Sys.getenv('EIVGP_RESULTS_ROOT')
    if(!nzchar(root))stop('Set run_dir or results_root to the saved Study I results')
    report<-eivGP::report_study1_eivgp(root,
      output_dir=if(nzchar(params$report_output))params$report_output else NULL,
      data_root=if(nzchar(params$data_root))params$data_root else NULL,
      ess_min=100,mixing_plots=params$mixing_plots)
  }
}
show_table<-function(x,caption,digits=3) {
  if(!nrow(x))cat('No saved rows are available.\n\n') else
    { names(x)<-gsub('_',' ',names(x)); cat('<div class="table-responsive">'); print(knitr::kable(x,format='html',table.attr='class="table table-striped table-condensed"',caption=caption,digits=digits,row.names=FALSE));cat('</div>\n\n') }
}
score_table<-function(x,metrics) {
  if(!nrow(x))return(x)
  out<-x[intersect(c('cell_id','n_calib','method'),names(x))]
  for(m in intersect(metrics,names(x)))out[[m]]<-
    ifelse(is.finite(x[[m]]),sprintf('%.3f [%.3f; %d]',x[[m]],x[[paste0(m,'_MCSE')]],x[[paste0(m,'_n')]]),'Not scored')
  out
}
```

```{r study-results, results='asis'}
if(is_eiv) {
cat('# Scope and completion\n\n')
cat('This report reads the saved **EIV-GP lane** of Study I. It includes the oracle and supplementary controls present in this run. External UC-GP, LVGP and EzGP comparisons belong to the competitor lane and are not claimed here.\n\n')
cat('Selected run: `',report$run_dir,'`.\n\n',sep='')
show_table(report$completion,'Saved execution status (historical gate warnings are not execution failures).')
show_table(do.call(rbind,lapply(report$config$cells,function(x)data.frame(cell=x$id,replications=x$n_rep,training=x$n,test=x$n_test,classes=x$m,calibration=paste(x$calibration_grid,collapse=', ')))), 'Saved study design.')
cat('\nScores below retain every completed replication. **No results are excluded because of a diagnostic flag.** Values are replication means; brackets contain the between-replication Monte Carlo standard error and the finite replication count. Those MCSEs differ from within-fit MCMC error.\n\n')
cat('# Prediction of a new response\n\nLower RMSE, CRPS, NLPD and interval score are better. Coverage95 and Width95 must be read together; nominal coverage is 0.95. Oracle rows have no calibration size because they are a reference shared across calibration settings.\n\n')
show_table(score_table(report$summaries$prediction,c('RMSE','CRPS','NLPD','Coverage95','Width95','IntervalScore95')),'Predictive performance.')
cat('\n# Observed-input mean m(x,c)\n\nThese summaries evaluate the mean conditional on the observed covariates and ordinal class, integrating the unobserved input.\n\n')
show_table(score_table(report$summaries$observed_mean,c('RMSE','Bias','Coverage95','Width95')),'Recovery of m(x,c).')
cat('\n# Latent response surface f(x,u)\n\nSurface recovery is assessed for eta=1 with calibration. It is not scored on an unanchored latent-input scale.\n\n')
show_table(score_table(report$summaries$latent_surface,c('ISE','Bias','Coverage95','Width95')),'Recovery of f(x,u).')
cat('\n# Training latent-input imputation\n\nWithout calibration, the physical location and scale of U are unanchored; those rows are explicitly not scored.\n\n')
show_table(score_table(report$summaries$latent_imputation,c('RMSE','Bias','Coverage95','Width95')),'Imputation of unobserved training inputs.')
cat('\n# Supplementary controls\n\nThese controls diagnose the role of input uncertainty and available calibration; they are not substitutes for the separately fitted published competitors.\n\n')
show_table(score_table(report$summaries$predictive_controls,c('RMSE','CRPS','Coverage95','Width95')),'Predictive controls.')
show_table(score_table(report$summaries$surface_controls,c('ISE','Coverage95','Width95')),'Surface-recovery controls.')
cat('\n# Scientific-target ESS and mixing\n\nThe requested criterion is **bulk ESS > ',report$ess_min,' and tail ESS > ',report$ess_min,'**, across the retained chains. R-hat and mean MCSE relative to posterior SD are supporting diagnostics, not additional pass/fail gates in this report. Missing ESS is listed as unavailable. Raw-coordinate and historical overall gate counts do not decide acceptability.\n\n',sep='')
if(!is.null(report$sampling) && nrow(report$sampling)) {
  extensions<-report$sampling[report$sampling$n_iter>20000L,,drop=FALSE]
  if(nrow(extensions)) {
    cat('The fits listed below were continued from their saved terminal states until every monitored scientific target exceeded the ESS requirement. All original post-warmup draws were retained; their scores were recomputed from the combined chains. Other fits were reused.\n\n')
    show_table(extensions[,c('cell_id','rep','n_calib','n_iter','burn','saved_per_chain')],'Saved-state continuations (iterations per chain).',digits=0)
  }
}
cat('Diagnostics use the complete retained chain windows recorded in the saved run. Scientific targets are monitored at five test locations per fit; this is not an exhaustive check over the whole prediction domain. Conditional-mean and second-moment diagnostics address different estimands. Target integrations use the saved finite integration design; their ESS does not measure integration approximation error.\n\n')
ess<-report$target_summary[,c('cell_id','n_calib','family','median_bulk_ess','min_bulk_ess','min_tail_ess','max_rhat','max_mcse_sd_ratio','below_ess')]
ess$cell_id<-sub('eta([01])_balanced','\\1',ess$cell_id)
labels<-c(m_conditional_mean='m mean',m_conditional_variance='m variance',f_conditional_mean='f mean',f_conditional_variance='f variance',predictive_second_moment='Predictive second moment',prospective_U_mean='Prospective U mean',prospective_U_second_moment='Prospective U second moment')
ess$family<-unname(labels[ess$family])
for(n in c('median_bulk_ess','min_bulk_ess','min_tail_ess'))ess[[n]]<-round(ess[[n]])
names(ess)<-c('eta','|O|','Target','Median bulk','Min bulk','Min tail','Max R-hat','Max MCSE/SD','ESS <= 100')
show_table(ess,'Scientific-target diagnostics across all replications. Full summaries and counts are retained in target_ess_summary.csv.',digits=3)
if(any(report$target_summary$unavailable>0))cat('**Some ESS values are unavailable; see the review table below.**\n\n')
cat('\n## Targets requiring closer inspection\n\n')
if(!nrow(report$review))cat('All saved monitored targets have finite bulk and tail ESS above the requested threshold. Trace inspection remains necessary.\n\n') else {
  cat(nrow(report$review),'monitored quantities in ',length(unique(paste(report$review$cell_id,report$review$n_calib,report$review$rep))),'fits have unavailable ESS or ESS at/below ',report$ess_min,'. The table identifies the affected quantities; a low ESS is not an execution failure.\n\n',sep='')
  show_table(report$review[,c('cell_id','n_calib','rep','parameter','ess_bulk','ess_tail','rhat','mcse_sd_ratio')], 'Low-ESS scientific targets.')
}
if(!is.null(report$inspection)) {cat('\n## Inspection of the saved traces\n\n');cat(paste(report$inspection,collapse='\n\n'));cat('\n\n')}
cat('\n# A few chain trace plots\n\nThree figures show typical observable-mean targets, the weakest uncertainty targets, and the continued scientific targets when extensions are present (otherwise, the weakest mean targets). The continued-target figure follows the weakest observable mean and predictive second moment in each extended fit; its dashed line marks the original 20,000-iteration endpoint. Typical replications are chosen near the median of the per-fit minimum m-mean bulk ESS; among historical archives only available retained fits can be traced. Weak cases are selected by the smallest bulk/tail ESS. The selection table and unavailable traces are retained.\n\nTraces use evenly spaced states across the entire post-warmup window, with four chains overlaid. ESS labels use the full-window diagnostic tables, never the displayed subset. No new MCMC is run.\n\n')
}
```

```{r status, results='asis'}
if(is_eiv) {
  if(nrow(report$figures$status)&&any(report$figures$status$status!='written')) {
    cat('\n**Some selected traces could not be produced.**\n\n')
    show_table(subset(report$figures$status,status!='written'),'Trace availability; missing traces are not evidence of good mixing.')
  }
  cat('\n# Output completeness and provenance\n\n')
  g<-report$completeness;g<-g[grepl('completeness',g$gate),]
  show_table(g[,intersect(c('cell_id','gate','expected','attempted','success','pass'),names(g))],'Saved output-completeness checks.')
  if(nrow(report$ablation_status))show_table(as.data.frame(table(report$ablation_status$cell_id,report$ablation_status$method,report$ablation_status$status)), 'Supplementary method execution statuses.')
  cat('\nReport data and CSV summaries: `',report$output_dir,'`. The source manifest records input file checksums. Saved results include verified continuations where requested; rendering this report does not alter fits or scores.\n\n',sep='')
  cat('To regenerate without fitting, run `study1-eivGP.R --action=report --run-dir=... --data-root=... --report-output=...`. For a new simulation use `--action=run`; the same script prepares and renders this HTML report. Rendering this notebook never fits or continues chains.\n\n')
}
```

```{r other-lanes, results='asis'}
if(!is_eiv) {
  root<-if(nzchar(params$results_root))params$results_root else Sys.getenv('EIVGP_RESULTS_ROOT')
  if(!nzchar(root))stop('Set results_root')
  source(file.path(here,'study1.R'),local=TRUE)
  if(params$lane=='historical') {
    result<-study1_analysis(root,'report',params$profile,params$cores,
      tables_dir=if(nzchar(params$tables_dir))params$tables_dir else NULL,
      competitor_dir=if(nzchar(params$competitor_dir))params$competitor_dir else NULL,
      mixing_plots=FALSE)
    cat('# Historical merged original-grid snapshot\n\n')
    show_table(result$summary,'Historical method comparison.')
    show_table(result$diagnostics,'Saved diagnostics.')
  } else {
    source(file.path(here,'study1-common.R'),local=TRUE)
    controls<-modifyList(list(action='report',profile=params$profile,output=root,cores=as.character(params$cores)),params$options)
    result<-study1_paper_workflow(params$lane,controls,NUMERICAL_REPO_ROOT)
    cat('# Saved competitor results\n\n');print(result)
  }
}
```
